sections.skill: Strategy: change the letters that must change, one at a time
sections.relationship: Students try random words. Comparing start and end letter by letter shows which letters must change and gives a lower limit on the number of steps.
sections.author_note: Students try random words. Comparing start and end letter by letter shows which letters must change and gives a lower limit on the number of steps.

lesson.title: Change the letters that must change, one at a time
text: Write the start word above the end word and circle each position where they differ. Each step changes one letter, so you need at least as many steps as circled positions.
Try changing one circled letter at a time, and check that each new word is on the list.
If no circled letter can change to a listed word, you may need a detour: change a letter that is already correct and change it back later. Detours add steps.

example.title: Worked example (a different list)
prompt: List: COT, CAT, HAT, HOT, HUT. Ladder from COT to HAT?
steps: COT and HAT differ in 2 positions (C/H, O/A): at least 2 steps.
COT -> CAT (O to A) -> HAT (C to H). Both words are listed, so 2 steps.
